stem: A ticketing platform needs to offload heavy reporting reads from its writer while accepting eventual consistency lag for those reports.

choices.text: Create read replicas and route reporting traffic to replica endpoints.
Rely on a Multi-AZ standby as the reporting read endpoint.
Use AWS Backup copy jobs as the online reporting query endpoint.
Use Elastic Disaster Recovery staging servers for near-real-time read scaling.

rationale: Read replicas are asynchronous read-only copies intended for read scaling and reporting. Multi-AZ standby replicas are for high availability and do not serve read traffic in that deployment mode. Backup copy jobs are for protection workflows, not query serving. Elastic Disaster Recovery staging infrastructure is for recovery orchestration, not primary reporting read paths.
